purpose: two-tier learning task: when an intervention opportunity exists (state level) and which candidate is better vs fallback (candidate level); replaces the single joint binary classifier task of pilot v2

parent_contracts.frozen_physics_thresholds_references: inherited unchanged from gate_p3; margins and dead-zones remain modification_prohibited

gate_split_v3.p3_verdict_preserved: underpowered_validation (immutable, never overwritten by the gate split)

map_facts.former_30pct_all_responsive_gate: declared inappropriate; remaining states must not be forced to produce joints

allowed_inputs: current and past 60-min hydraulic state (5-min sampled)
forbidden_inputs: exact SWMM search results or any function of them (offline labels only)
reference branch outcomes not available online
state_level_head.exact_search_results_role: offline labels only, never model inputs

candidate_level_heads.joint_label_policy: joint noninferiority is composed from the continuous/safety heads (pfv_safe AND tfv delta within margin AND peak delta within margin); no standalone joint binary classifier gate

flat_policy.response_magnitude: continuous label (replaces flat binary as primary signal)

sources: feasibility map samples eligible for development training

training_eligibility.rule: exact-search samples from calibration/validation/challenge states must never enter training; only pilot_train state search samples are training-eligible

oracle_revealed_policy.rule: oracle-searched non-train states must not be reused as unseen evaluation; evaluation splits are re-labelled and any state whose exact search informed development is flagged oracle_revealed
oracle_revealed_policy.replacement_source: if locked validation feasible states are insufficient, add unseen development validation events from the 182-event standard pool; never reuse oracle-searched states

underpowered_validation_rule.consequence: train1600 not authorized; add independent unseen development validation events from the standard pool; never reuse oracle-searched states

train1600_redesign.authorization: data generation is authorized by PROJECT6_V4_DATA_GENERATION_AUTHORIZATION_V3 (train1600_planning_authorized=true); the P3 verdict stays underpowered_validation and is never overwritten; model safety remains deferred under PROJECT6_V4_MODEL_SAFETY_GATE_V3; formal 1600-sample SWMM runs never start automatically
train1600_redesign.target: 64 events x 5 states x 5 accepted samples = 1600

prohibitions: no exact search results as online model features
no training on calibration/validation/challenge exact-search samples
no reuse of oracle-revealed states as unseen evaluation
no modification of frozen margins or dead-zones
no overwriting of the P3 underpowered_validation verdict
no relabelling of no_joint_found_under_budget as physically infeasible
no Active Learning on Calibration or Locked Validation results
no future SWMM results as online candidate generator inputs
